verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for an LLM observability SDK and platform like W&B Weave, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'tracking' evidence covers tracing and cost tracking of the user's own application, which is a different feature from the vendor collecting usage data on Weave itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
